scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @kivro/database exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @kivro/database exec prisma generate
scripts.db:setup: pnpm db:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm db:migrate
